content: Isaye fãs hazarore hána hábaiye
Iyar bade Isaye Galil doriyar dusora farot giye, (ziyanore Ṭaiberiya doriya o ho.)
Ar ek beši ḍõr mainšor dole hibar fise fise giye, kiyollahoile hibaye biyaraimma okkolore aram goijjilde he keramot okkol hitara dekkil.
Tarfore Isaye ek faharor uwore giye edde heṛe hibaye hibar sahabi okkolore loi boišše.
Hẽtte Ihudi uddar id hãse aššil.
Toi Isaye hibar suk tuille ek ḍõr mainšor dol hibar mikka aiyedde dekiyore, hibaye Filipore hodde,

content.text: "Itara háibolla ãra ruṭi hontu kiniyum?"

content: Hibaye hitare ei hotagan šude forikka goribolla hoiye, kiyollahoile hibaye ki goribo hiyan hibaye agottu loti zanito.
Filipe hibare zuwabe hodde, "Hitarar fotti ekzone ek ṭukura gori faibolla dui šot dinaror ruṭiye o no kulaibo!"
Hibar sahabi okkol butore ekzon, Andreas, Simon Fitoror bái, hite hibare hodde,
"Eṛe ek gura fuwattu fãswa buṭkar aṭar ruṭi edde duwa mas ase, kintu edun mainšore hin diyore ki oibo?"
Isaye hodde,

content.text: "Mainšore buwagorai do."

content: He zagaganot beši ker aššil, manuš okkol heṛe uwore boišše. (Onumanik fãs hazar furuš manuš heṛe aššil.)
Tarfore Isaye he ruṭigun loi Allare šukuriya zanaiye edde zara boišše hitara ze zedun saiye hitare hedun hedun bag gori diye. Hibaye mas o hen gori bag gori diye.
Toi hitara beggune feṭ bori hái bade hibaye sahabi okkolore hodde,

content.text: "Ze ṭuragun basi roiye hin beggun ekku fũwati dola goro, zene kissu nošto oi no zagoi."

content: Toi hitara hen goijje, hána hái bade ze he fãswa ruṭittu ṭura basi aššil hinore hitara dola gori baro barang oiye.
Isar ei keramoti ham deki mainše howahoi šuru goijje, "Iba oilde he nobi ze duniyait aiyer."
Isaye buzi faijje ze hitara aibo edde hitara hibare raza banaibolla zur goribo; hetolla hiba hentu šoṛi zaigoiyore ekela abar faharot giyegoi.
Isaye fanir uwottu ãiṭṭe
Toi hazinna zehon oiye, sahabi okkol lamat doriyar hãsat giye,
edde ekkan not uiṭṭe edde Kofornahumor mikka baisa diye. Ar hẽtte andar aiššil edde ehon o Isaye hitara loi ottor no o.
Heṛe beši zure bataš bonor zoriya fani beši utaltal oiye.
Hitara zẽtte tin sair mail no solai giye, bade dekedde Isaye fanir uwottu ãṛiyore hitarar mikka agguwai aiyer. Ar hitara beši ḍoraiye.
Kintu Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Iba ãi, no ḍoraiyo."

content: Hitara hibare not tuli loito saiye, edde hehon nogan hitara zeṛe zat aššil he zagar kulot fõissegoi.

Tarfordin, ze manuš okkol doriyar oinno farot tiyai aššil, hitara deikke ze, heṛe ekkan bade ar hono no nu aššil, ar ze hibar sahabi okkol ziyanot uiṭṭe, Isaye hibar sahabi okkolor fũwati no hiyanot no uṛe, kintu hitara ekela gilgoi.
Ar Ṭaiberiyattu ho ekkan no, zeṛe Malike šukuriya zanai bade mainše ruṭi háil, he zagar ḍake aišše.
Mainšor dol okkole zehon dekilo ze Isa otóba hibar sahabi okkol kiye heṛe nai, hetunot hitara nogunot uiṭṭe edde Isare tuwaibolla Kofornahumot giye.
Isa he zibonor ruṭi
Ar hitara hibare doriyar ofarot faiyore, hitara hibare hodde, "Rabbi, õne eṛe hõtte aiššo?"
Isaye hitarare zuwab diye edde hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, tũwara sinnor ham deikko boli tũwara ãre tuwodde no, bolke feṭ bori ruṭi hái faijjo boli.
Nošto oi zaiboide hánalla ham no goijjo, bolke hána zin akeri zibon foijjonto takibo, zin Adomor Fute tũwarare dibo, hinolla goro. Kiyollahoile he Baf Allah nize hibar uwore sil maijje."

content: Henot hitara hibare fusar goredde, "Henoile ãra Allar ham okkol goribolla ãrattu ki gora foribo?"
Isaye hitarare zuwabe hodde,

content.text: "Allar ham oilde in: hibar uwore biššaš ano, zare Allaye defeṛaiye."

content: Toi hitara hibare hodde, "Õne ki en sinno goror, zin dekiyore ãra õnore biššaš gori faijjum? Õne en ki ham goriba de?
Ãrar bafdada okkole bošoti sara elehat manna háil, zendilla leka ase: 'Hibaye hitarare behostottu háibolla ruṭi diye.'"
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi soiyi hoir, tũwarare ruṭi behostottu Musaye diyede no, kintu ãr Bafe tũwarare behostottu he soiyi ruṭi de.
Kiyollahoile Allar ruṭi oilde hiba ze ruṭi behostottu nise lami aiye edde duniyaire zibon de."

content: Hitara hodde, "Malik, ei ruṭi ãrare hamiša do."
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi oilamde he zibon ruṭi; hite ze ãr hãse aiye, hitattu buka no lagibo, ar hite ze ãre uwore biššaš ane, hite tiraši no oibo, hono dinolla.
Kintu ãi tũwarare hoiyi, tũwara ãre deikko, ar ehon o biššaš no goror.
Bafe zarare ãre diye, hitara beggun ãr hãse aibo, ar hite ze ãr hãse aiye, hitare ãi honodin baire felai no diyum.
Kiyollahoile ãi behostottu ãr issa mozin ham goribolla lami aiššide no, bolke hibar issa furon goribolla, ze ãre defeṛaiye.
Ar ze ãre defeṛaiye, hibar issa oilde iyan ze, hibaye beggun zarare ãre diye, hentu ekzon o zene ãi no harai, bolke šešor dinot hitarare uwafes tuli.
Ar ãr Bafor issa oilde iyan ze, fotti ekzon ze Futore sa edde hibar uwore biššaš ane, hite akeri zibon fa; ar ãi hitarare šešor dinot uwafes tuliyum."

content: Henot Ihudi okkole hibar berudde monmona šuru goijje, kiyollahoile hibaye hoil,

content.text: "Ãi he ruṭi ze behostottu nise lami aišši."

content: Hitara hodde, "Iba ki Yusufor fut, Isa no ne? Zar baf mare ãra sini? Ite kengori endilla hoi fare,

content.text: 'ãi behostottu nise lami aišši'

content: Isaye zuwabe hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara ekzon loi ar ekzone monmonani bon goro;
Ãr Baf, ze ãre defeṛaiye, hibaye ṭani nu anile honokiye ãr hãse ai no fare, ar ãi hitare šešor dinot uwafes tuliyum.
Nobi okkolor kitabot leka ase: 'Hitara beggune Allar duwara šikka faibo.' Fottikiye ze Bafore funer edde hibattu šikka fa, hite ãr hãse aiyer.
Endilla no ze Bafore honokiye deke, hiba ze Allar hãsottu aišše, šude hibaye deikke Bafore.
Ãi tũwarare soiyi soiyi hoir, hite ze ãr uwore biššaš ane hitattu akeri zibon ase.
Ãi oilamde he zibonor ruṭi.
Tũwarar bafdada okkole bošoti sara elehat manna háil, ar hitara morigiyegoi.
Iba oilde he ruṭi ziba behostottu nise lami aišše, zene ze honokiye hibattu há, edde no morer.
Ãi oilamde he zinda ruṭi, ziba behostottu lami aišše. Hite ze ei ruṭi há, hite sirohalolla basibo. Ar ze ruṭi ãi diyum hiyan oilde ãr ga, ziyan ãi diyum duniyair zibonolla."

content: Ei hota funiyore Ihudi okkol ekzone ar ekzon loi doromoro barabari gori howa šuru goijje, "Ite kengori ãrare hitar ga haito di fare?"
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi soiyi hoir, Adomor Futor gusto zodi no ho, ar zodi no fiyo hibar lou, toile tũwarar butore zibon nai.
Hite ze ãr gusto edde lou há hitattu akeri zibon ase, ar ãi šeš dinot hitare uwafes tuliyum.
Ãr gusto oilde asol hána, ãr lou oilde asol fibar ziniš.
Hite ze ãr gusto edde lou há, hite ãr butore take ar ãi o hitar butore taki.
Zendilla zinda Bafe ãre defeṛaiye ar hibar duwara zinda asi, ṭik hendilla ze ãre há hite o ãr duwara zinda takibo.
Iba oilde he ruṭi ze behostottu nise lami aišše. Tũwarar bafdada okkole manna háil edde morigiyegoi, kintu ze honokiye ei ruṭi háibo hite sirohalolla basibo."

content: In okkol hibaye Kofornahumor sinagogot šikka dedde šomot hoil.
Bout kiye Isar šikkat monmonaiye
Hibar sahabi okkolor butore boute ei hota funiyore hodde, "In beši koṭin šikka. Hone inore gosi faribo?"
Hibar sahabi okkole ei babute monmonar, hiyan Isaye buzi fariyore hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Iyanor zoriya ki tũwara forizorgoi?
Hetunot tũwara ki bafiba Adomor Fut age zeṛe aššil heṛe uṛi zargoide dekile?
Ruhuye zibon de; gustoye hono kissu faida no de, ze hota okkol ãi tũwarare hoilam, hin oilde Ruh edde zibon.
Tarfore o tũwarar butore en hozon ase, zara biššaš no gore."

content: Kiyollahoile Isaye šuruttu loti zanito, hitara hontara zara hibare biššaš goribo, ar hite honnuwa ze hibar loi beimani goribo.
Ar hibaye hodde,

content.text: "Etolla ãi tũwarare hoilam, zodi ãr Bafor torfottu kemota diya no o, toile honokiye ãr hãse ai no fare."

content: Iyar bade hibar bout sahabi okkol uwafes firi giyegoi edde hibar loi ar sola fira no gore.
Toi Isaye he barozonore fusar goijje,

content.text: "Tũwara o ki uwafes firi zaibolla issa goror?"

content: Simon Fitore zuwabe hodde, "Malik, ãra har hãse zaiyum? Akeri zibonor kalam to õnor hãse ase.
Ãra biššaš goijji, ãra zani ze, õne Allar he Pakzon."
Toi Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Ãi ki tũwara barozonore basi no loi ne? Zodi o tũwarar butore ekzon šoitan."

content: (Ei hota hibaye Iskariyoti Simonor fut Ehudar babute hoiyede, kiyollahoile hite, he barozonor butore ekzon oi bade o, hiba loi beimani goribo.)
